name: Telegram 2FA Bot
description: A secure Telegram bot for managing 2FA keys and generating TOTP codes. Features anti-spam protection, session-based storage, and automatic message deletion for security.

API_ID.description: Your Telegram API ID (get it from https://my.telegram.org/apps). Must be a numeric value.

API_HASH.description: Your Telegram API Hash (get it from https://my.telegram.org/apps). Should be a 32-character hexadecimal string.

BOT_TOKEN.description: Your Telegram Bot Token (get it from @BotFather). Format: 1234567890:ABCdefGHIjklMNOpqrSTUvwxYZ
